tags.name: Domestic Standing Orders
tags.description: Danske Bank only supports GBP standing orders for one fixed amount on a specified frequency for a defined period or open-ended. Standing Orders can only be requested on GBP current accounts and are only processed Monday to Friday. Payments within the standing order schedule which fall on a weekend or holiday will be processed on the following working day. First payment date/time cannot be greater than 1 year.
